description: Land Acquisition - Welamitiyawa, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of three specific land allotments for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of the land parcels, including their locations, boundaries, extents, and adjacent landowners. The content is exclusively focused on land matters (acquisition), falling squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
